reason: A UI enhancement plugin that lets users upload, adjust, persist, and clear a global wallpaper behind the chat column using CSS overrides.

summaries.zh: 通过上传图片、调整遮罩透明度和清除设置来定制聊天列背景的界面增强插件。
summaries.en: A UI enhancement plugin for uploading, adjusting, persisting, and clearing a global wallpaper behind the chat column.

capabilities: customizes the chat background with a user-selected image
persists background settings in the user-settings document
applies CSS and DOM style enhancements in the browser

reasons.code: UI-only customization with no model-visible tool or provider request
User-selected raster images are downsampled and stored as data URLs in settings
